title: Farewell/ambient lines don't always update after a topic is resolved in the same conversation: Elgin's parting line ('come back, if you ever find a way to lay two unforgiving lines to rest at once') fires right after he thanks the player for doing exactly that; Merle's parting line ('some things out there still answer back') fires right after she says 'I haven't heard the pull since.'
